transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

I go from feeling like I can work nonstop and take on everything to suddenly having no energy to even show up for my shifts. My manager and my mom both got really worried about these dramatic changes in me, so I agreed to come in and get checked out.

Have you ever had a period of at least several days when you felt unusually energetic or irritable, needed much less sleep, talked more than usual, or did risky things, and have you also had times of feeling down or losing interest for at least two weeks?

Yes, that describes exactly what I've been going through. I had a period where I felt incredibly energetic, barely slept, talked constantly, and worked nonstop, but for the last three months I've crashed into a heavy low where I've lost interest in everything like soccer and cooking and can barely get to work.
Have you ever had a time when those low symptoms lasted for at least 2 years without a break of more than a couple of months?

No, it definitely hasn't been that long. This heavy, low stretch has only been hanging over me for about three months now. In fact, the whole back-and-forth cycle with my mood only started about four months ago.
During your high-energy periods, did the symptoms last for at least 4 days if it was a hypomanic episode, or at least 1 week if it was a manic episode?
Yes, it definitely lasted much longer than a week. That high-energy period actually went on for about a month before I crashed into this low stretch. So it was way more than just a few days.
During this low period, have you had any thoughts that life is not worth living, thoughts of hurting yourself, or any suicidal thoughts?
No, I haven't had any thoughts of hurting myself or anything like that. I'm just feeling incredibly exhausted and down, and I really want to find a way to get my normal life back.
During your low periods, do you also have any symptoms of mania or hypomania, such as feeling unusually energized, needing much less sleep, racing thoughts, or being more talkative than usual?

No, I don't experience any of those high-energy feelings during my low periods; those are strictly part of my 'up' phases. When I'm in a low stretch, it's the complete opposite—I feel totally drained, exhausted, and can barely get myself to move or speak.
During your high or low mood episodes, have you ever had hallucinations, heard or seen things others did not, or had beliefs that others said were clearly untrue?
No, I’ve never experienced anything like that. I have never heard or seen things that weren't actually there, and I've never held any beliefs that other people found completely untrue or impossible.

During your high-energy periods, do you also have any depressive symptoms like feeling hopeless, guilty, or losing interest at the same time? And during your low periods, do you ever still feel unusually energized, restless, or need much less sleep?

No, those states are completely separate for me; when I'm on a high streak, I feel on top of the world and don't feel hopeless or lose interest at all. When I'm in a low stretch, I don't have any of that unstoppable energy, though I do sometimes pace or fidget out of frustration because I feel so stuck and slow.

During your high-energy periods, do you ever also have any depressive symptoms like feeling hopeless, guilty, or losing interest at the same time? And during your low periods, do you ever still feel unusually energized, restless, or need much less sleep?

They are completely separate for me. When I'm on a high streak, I feel on top of the world, extremely motivated, and confident, with no hopeless feelings at all. When I'm low, I just feel totally wiped out and exhausted, rather than energized, even if I sometimes pace around because I'm frustrated at how slow I'm moving.
During your high-energy periods, did you ever hear or see things that other people couldn’t, or believe things that others thought were clearly untrue?
No, I didn't experience anything like that during my high periods either. I never heard or saw things that weren't real, and I didn't hold any beliefs that were completely out of touch with reality.
Has your current low mood and loss of interest been present nearly every day for at least 2 weeks, or has it been shorter or intermittent?

Yes, it has been present nearly every single day, not intermittent at all. This heavy, exhausted stretch has been hanging over me consistently for about three months now, making it really hard to work or even do basic things around the apartment.

During your high-energy or low periods, have you ever had hallucinations or strongly believed things that others said were not true? This would help determine whether the episodes had psychotic features.
No, I have never experienced seeing or hearing things that aren't actually there, during either my high or low periods. I also haven't held any beliefs that others told me were completely untrue.

During your high-energy or low periods, have you ever had hallucinations or strongly believed things that others said were not true? This would help determine whether the episodes had psychotic features.

No, I’ve never seen or heard things that weren't there, and I didn't believe anything completely unreal. The closest thing was just being extremely overconfident about my business plans during my high periods, thinking I could easily launch a whole food truck chain in a year. But there were definitely no hallucinations or anything like that.
During your high or low episodes, have you ever had hallucinations or beliefs that were clearly not true, like thinking others were trying to harm you or that you had special powers?

No, I've never experienced anything like that. I never believed I had actual supernatural or special powers, and I never felt like people were trying to harm me. It was really just a massive boost in my regular confidence, not anything out of touch with reality.
Right now, do you feel mainly depressed and slowed down, or are you also having the high-energy symptoms again like needing much less sleep, racing thoughts, or feeling unusually confident?

Right now, and for the last three months, I am definitely stuck in the low, slowed-down phase. I feel completely wiped out, and even trying to move around feels like I'm walking through deep mud. The high-energy symptoms like racing thoughts or feeling super confident are not active at all right now; those only happened earlier.

Have you ever had any other high-energy symptoms during your 'up' periods, like feeling unusually important or invincible, being much more talkative than usual, or doing impulsive things like spending too much money or risky behavior?

Yes, during my high periods I felt incredibly important and confident, even lecturing my manager on how to run his business and believing I could easily launch a massive food truck chain in a year. I also talked constantly and jumped from topic to topic so fast that others couldn't get a word in, to the point where I felt physically uncomfortable if there was any silence.
During this low period, have you had any thoughts that you would be better off dead, or any thoughts of harming yourself?
No, I haven't had any thoughts of wanting to die or hurting myself at all. I just feel completely exhausted and drained of all my energy, like I'm running on empty every single day.
Have your current low symptoms lasted at least 2 weeks continuously, or have they been shorter than that?

Yes, they have lasted much longer than two weeks. This heavy, low stretch has been hanging over me continuously for about three months now. It's been so constant that I've barely been able to get myself to work or take care of things around my apartment.
Have you ever had a similar depressive episode like this before, or is this the first time you’ve had a low period lasting this long?

This is actually the first time I've ever experienced a low period like this. The whole cycle of going from feeling unstoppable to completely drained started about four months ago when I began working extra double shifts, and this current low stretch has been going on for about three months.
Before this current low period, have you ever had any other episodes of depression or a long stretch of feeling down and losing interest that lasted at least 2 weeks?
No, I haven't ever had another low period like this before. This current stretch, which hit me after my high period a few months ago, is the very first time I've ever felt this down and drained.
Have you ever had any prior manic, hypomanic, or major depressive episodes before this past 4 months, even if they were milder or shorter?
No, I haven't really experienced anything like this before this recent four-month period. This is the very first time my mood and energy have swung so drastically.

Have you ever had any earlier periods before these last 4 months where you felt unusually high, energetic, or depressed for several days or longer? This helps tell whether this is a first episode or a recurring mood disorder.
No, I haven't really experienced periods like this before these past four months. This is the very first time my mood and energy have ever swung so dramatically.
Have these mood episodes been happening for at least a year, or did they only start within the last few months?

They only started within the last few months. The back-and-forth mood swings have been happening for about four months, starting when I took on extra double shifts at the restaurant. This heavy, low phase has been going on for about three months of that time.
Have you ever had any similar episodes of high energy or depression before these last few months, even if they were shorter or milder?

No, I don't recall ever having episodes like this before. All of these intense ups and downs really just started about four months ago when I began working those extra double shifts at the restaurant.
Have these mood episodes been happening for at least 1 year, or did they only start within the last few months?

No, they haven't been going on for a year at all; it's only been about four months. It all started when I began picking up those extra double shifts at the restaurant to save money. This heavy, low stretch has been hanging over me for about three months of that time.
Have your mood episodes been happening for at least 1 year, or did they only start within the last few months?

No, they definitely haven't been going on for a year—it's only been about four months since this all started when I began working those extra double shifts. Out of that time, this heavy, low stretch has been going on for about three months now.
Have you ever had any mood episodes like this before these last four months, even if they were milder or shorter?
No, I haven't really experienced anything like this before these past four months. It all seemed to start when I began taking on those extra double shifts at the restaurant to save money.
Have your mood episodes ever happened in a repeating pattern over time, or is this the first and only time you’ve had these ups and downs?

This is the very first time I've ever experienced these extreme ups and downs. It all started about four months ago when I began taking on those extra double shifts, which kicked off that period where I felt completely unstoppable. Since then, it gave way to this heavy, low stretch that has been lasting for the past three months.
Have you ever had any earlier manic, hypomanic, or major depressive episodes before these last four months, even if they were milder or shorter?

No, I've never experienced anything like this before these past four months. This is the very first time I've ever had these kinds of mood swings, even mild ones. I was always pretty steady before this.
Have these high and low mood episodes continued for at least 1 year, or did they only start within the last few months?

They definitely only started within the last few months. The overall back-and-forth has been going on for about four months since I started taking on those extra shifts, and this heavy, low stretch has lasted for about three months now.
